data.desc: Founded in 1997, MDB Capital focuses on launching 'Big Ideas' through a unique approach to public venture capital. The firm emphasizes community-driven financings of early-stage leaders in significant business and technology categories via early public offerings, primarily on NASDAQ, as well as post-IPO offerings for qualifying companies. MDB Capital Holdings, LLC (NASDAQ: MDBH) and its subsidiaries operate under the MDB Capital brand, including Public Ventures, LLC (d/b/a MDB Capital), a venture-focused broker-dealer that operates the MDB Direct trading platform, and PatentVest, Inc., an intellectual property law firm.
